description: A small gold cube-shaped box sits on a red bedspread, with a small patterned cat-shaped trinket and loop in front of it. The left hand stays resting on the bed while the right hand moves in from the right, pinches and lifts the trinket, carries it forward and upward over the box, then lowers and releases it so it ends up stacked on top of the box, with the right hand withdrawing afterward.
